title: LITE-1b a web device's push subscription
description: POST /v1/push/subscriptions (201) with the browser's PushSubscription.toJSON() - {endpoint, keys{p256dh, auth}, expirationTime?} - web credential only; one subscription per device, a new one replaces it. The endpoint must be https on a known push service (Apple, FCM, Mozilla autopush, WNS). The answer never repeats the endpoint or keys.
